name: Fargodeep Mine
summary: Kobolds now swarm through Fargodeep Mine, south of Goldshire in central Elwynn Forest. Its gold once filled Stormwind's treasury, but now kobolds make their home in its tunnels.

sections.title: A Lost Vein
sections.body: Gold once flowed from Fargodeep Mine into Stormwind's treasury. As the Kingdom's military presence in Elwynn dwindled, the outlying mine grew vulnerable. Kobolds filled its dark tunnels and made a warren beneath the hills. Now Marshal Dughan and Goldshire's authorities fear the lost ore and the danger to nearby farms, including the Stonefield and Maclure holdings.

sections.title: Depths of the Warren
sections.body: Fargodeep Mine runs through several levels, with lower shafts reaching deep beneath the forest floor. Kobold laborers and vermin hurry along wooden scaffolds, guarding the wax and gold dust they have scavenged. Goldtooth, a cunning kobold leader, lurks in a den above the main tunnels. He hoards trinkets stolen from travelers and nearby residents.

faq.q: Why did Stormwind abandon Fargodeep Mine?
faq.answer: Stormwind neglected Fargodeep Mine as its military stretched thin across the southern lands. Town guards focused on Goldshire and the main roads, leaving the underground mine unguarded. Kobolds moved in and fortified its tunnels.

faq.q: Why are the kobolds here so dangerous to local farmers?
faq.answer: Fargodeep Mine lies between the Stonefield and Maclure family farms. Kobolds come out of its tunnels to steal livestock, tools, and personal belongings. They also harass anyone near the entrance.
Goldtooth is a prominent kobold who nests in a den in Fargodeep Mine's upper reaches. He is known for stealing Auntie Bernice Stonefield's prized family necklace.

faq.q: Why do people in Goldshire want items from the mine?
faq.answer: People in Goldshire see a reason to clear the pests from Fargodeep Mine. Remy 'Two Times' buys salvaged gold dust, while the alchemist William Pestle uses kobold candle wax for reagents. Marshal Dughan needs the infestation monitored to protect Elwynn.

angles.text: Though pests infest Fargodeep Mine, its rocky tunnels still hold accessible copper veins for new miners.
Clearing the vermin from Fargodeep Mine helps secure the supply lines and farmlands around Goldshire.
